verdict.rationale: LibreChat has a dedicated 'User Memory' docs page, indicating a built-in long-term memory feature exists, but the evidence pack only gives the page title with no detail on how memory is written, recalled, or persisted across sessions, nor any independent/hands-on confirmation it works reliably. Missing for 10: details on automatic memory capture/recall mechanics, user controls for reviewing/editing memories, and independent verification of cross-session persistence.
